intent: Flatten linux_configuration by dissolving the scripts/ and single_use/ levels, cutting directory-depth violations nearly in half and making the depth-2 cap reachable.
scope: single_use/lib/joplin_server.sh -> installers/, freeing lib/ for the shared library
~90 files rewritten for the new paths; 16 $HOME symlinks repointed
Non-goal: periodic_background/digital_wellbeing and hosts, deferred pending the guard-lib repoint
changes: git mv'd every category out of scripts/single_use/ and scripts/ up to linux_configuration/, then removed the two empty parents. scripts/tests/ held only an untracked __pycache__ and was deleted.
Rewrote absolute references (linux_configuration/scripts/... -> linux_configuration/...) across 38 files, and relative ../scripts/X forms across the docs and harnesses that used them.
Recomputed every relative `source` of lib/common.sh and lib/android.sh per file depth: 40 files were ../../ and 12 were ../../../, and the correct prefix differs by where the file now sits.
Fixed REPO_ROOT in 7 fixes/lib/tests harnesses plus setup_syncyomi_guard.sh, which walked up four levels from a directory that is now two levels shallower.
Repointed 16 symlinks in $HOME: the whole i3blocks bar, keepass-open, and two diagnostics tools.
Fixed linux_configuration/.gitignore's two secret paths and meta/shell-coverage-allowlist.txt's joplin_server entry.
Fixed linux_configuration/tests/conftest.py, whose sys.path entries for fast_count and the transcribe tools still named the old tree.
Documented the new layout in AGENTS.md and removed the last stale billsplit references.

verification.evidence: 248 -> 139 violations. Roughly 40 of the remainder are inside digital_wellbeing and hosts, which are deliberately deferred.

verification.command: resolve every '$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/...' source against the filesystem
verification.evidence: First sweep left 5 files in misc/testsAndMisc-bash pointing at ../../../lib/common.sh (they had a different prefix than the 40 already fixed). After the second pass every source resolves. Checked by testing the path on disk, not by reading the diff.

8 of 9 pass. features/lib/tests fails 'REFUSING: must run under shell_coverage_jail.sh' -- confirmed identical in the pre-move baseline worktree, so it is the suite's jail requirement, not a regression. fixes/lib/tests DID regress (log_warn: command not found) and was fixed by correcting REPO_ROOT; it passes again.
First run: 14 collection errors from conftest.py's stale sys.path. After the fix: 1798 passed, TOTAL coverage 100.00%.

verification.command: find ~ -maxdepth 4 -xtype l -lname '*testsAndMisc*'; then run the i3blocks scripts
verification.evidence: 16 broken symlinks immediately after the move, including the entire i3blocks bar. After repointing, zero broken, and cpu_monitor/memory/disk/time/volume all emit real output (e.g. '54°C, 1.18', '17.9GiB/30.4GiB').

verification.command: git check-ignore on the two secret configs; check_shell_coverage.sh --all
verification.evidence: features/.wireguard_ssh.conf and .dufs_cloud.conf are still ignored after their gitignore paths changed. Coverage gate exits 0 and every allowlist entry names a file that exists.

risks: This renames ~400 tracked files. Anything outside this repo and outside $HOME that hardcodes linux_configuration/scripts/... would break; report_live_state.sh covers systemd, /etc, /usr/local and $HOME symlinks, and all of those were checked.
docs/superpowers/ artifacts still quote old paths. They are dated records of past work and were deliberately not rewritten.
features/lib/tests remains jail-only. That predates this change but means one suite is not exercised by a bare run.
rollback: git revert restores the tree; the symlinks then need repointing back, which the same one-liner does with the substitution reversed.
Re-run pytest_changed_packages.py and the lib/tests suites to confirm the restored state.
